paite: I thugen uh kua'n agingta a? TOUPA khut kua kiang ah ahia akihil?
heading: Jehovah Thuakna
english: Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?

paite: Ama ah thilpou noutak bang in amah lah adawnkhia a, lei keu a pan zung bang in akhangkhia hi; piandan hoihna leh mel kilawmna himhim anei kei a; amah i muh un amah i deihna ding un kilawmna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

paite: Amah mihingte muhsit leh deih louh in a-om a; dahnate neimi leh natna thei mi ahi a; amah lak a i mai uh sel bang i hi ua, muhsit in a-om a, e'n lah amah i ngaisang tuan kei uhi.
english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

paite: Ama'n i natnate pua in, i dahnate leng apo ngei a; himahleh e'n bel dahna khu, Pathian vuak, hihgentheih in i bawl ngal ua.
english: Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.

paite: Ahih hang in i tatleknate ziak in amah liam in a-om a, i thulimlouhnate ziak in vuak sidup in a-om a; i lungmuanna ding in atung ah sawina akia a; avuakna golhte a hihdam in i omta hi.
english: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

paite: I vek un belam bang in i vakmang ua; eimah lampi tuam chiat uah i pialta uh; TOUPA'N amah tung ah i vek ua thulimlouhna angata hi!
english: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

paite: Amah nuaisiah in a-om a, himahleh akingainiam a, akam aka kei; belamnou goh ding api uh bang leh, belam amulmet mite ma a adai dide bang mai in; ahi, akam aka kei hi.
english: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is silent, so he didn’t open his mouth.

paite: Nuaisiahna leh vaihawmna a lakmang in a-om a; adam tonpihte'n houh kua'n ahia mihing gam a kipan hihman a a-om ngaihtuah mahmah? Ka mite tatlekna ziak a dahna khu ahih.
english: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. As for his generation, who considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living and stricken for the disobedience of my people?

paite: Huan hiamgam ahih ngei kei a, akam ah zekhemna om ngei kei mahleh, ahan migiloute kiang ah asehsak ua, asih nung in mihausa kiang ah a-om hi.
english: They made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death, although he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

paite: TOUPA'N, amah vuak sidup a-ut him ahi; adahsakta ngei a; ahinna khelhna a dia thillat ding a na zat peuhpeuh chiang in, achisuan amuta ding a, adamsung nite asausak ding, TOUPA deihlam akhut ah lohching in a-om ding hi.
english: Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will see his offspring. He will prolong his days and Yahweh’s pleasure will prosper in his hand.

paite: Akha nauvei gim gah amu ding a, alungkimta ding; ka sikha diktattak in atheihna in mi tampi'n siam atang ding ua, athulimlouhnate uh apuaksak ding.
english: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

paite: Huaiziak in miliante tantuan amah ka hawm ding a, gallak sumte ama'n mihatte ahawm sam ding hi; ahinna pen si khop hial a asunbuak a, talekte lak a simtel a a-om ziak in; himahleh mi tampi khelhna apua a, talekte athumsak hi.
english: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great. He will divide the plunder with the strong, because he poured out his soul to death and was counted with the transgressors; yet he bore the sins of many and made intercession for the transgressors.
